# Multimodal models

[简体中文](../../../../learning/paths/multimodal-models/index.md) · English

Study three questions: how to align modalities, how to budget visual evidence, and how to predict states and the consequences of actions.

Choose a subtopic and start with its paper questions.

<article class="ar-learning-topic-tile">

<p>How do images, speech, and text connect to the same task? Does the model learn similarity or learn to generate answers?</p>

</article>
<article class="ar-learning-topic-tile">
